title: Essences Guide: Tiers, Guaranteed Mods and Crafting Risk
summary: Essences are a targeted crafting currency that guarantees one specific modifier on gear. This guide covers the tier ladder, which modifier each essence family grants per item slot, how Perfect and Corrupted essences behave, and how to combine them with Omens to control Prefix or Suffix removal.
description: A source-linked reference for Essences in Path of Exile 2: tier ladder, guaranteed modifier tables, Perfect vs Corrupted risk, Omen of Crystallisation combos, valid targets, and craft order.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Essence currency item icon from Path of Exile 2 - a glowing crystalline orb that grants a guaranteed modifier when used on equipment

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Use an Essence when you want one guaranteed modifier instead of a random roll. Lesser, Normal and Greater essences upgrade a Magic item into a Rare and add one fixed modifier; a Perfect Essence removes a random modifier from a Rare and replaces it with a stronger guaranteed one.
calloutDetail: Perfect and Corrupted essences can delete a modifier you wanted to keep - that is the main risk.
An Omen of Sinistral or Dextral Crystallisation limits which side (Prefix or Suffix) a Perfect/Corrupted essence is allowed to remove.

answers.label: Use it for
text: Targeted crafting: a specific defensive, elemental or life modifier you cannot reliably hit with random currency.

answers.label: Pair it with
text: Omen of Sinistral/Dextral Crystallisation when using Perfect or Corrupted essences on an item that already has good mods.

answers.label: Hold off if
text: The base is a finished Rare where losing any current modifier would ruin the item.

sections.title: Essence families and what they grant
intro: Each essence family is tied to one stat. The exact modifier and its tier depend on the family and on the item slot you use it on (weapon, armour, or jewellery). Below are the families players reach for most often.

members.title: Essence of the Body
body: Grants a large flat or percentage Life modifier. On a Body Armour a Perfect roll gives roughly +8-10% Maximum Life; on jewellery it grants flat Life.

members.title: Essence of Abrasion
body: Adds flat Physical Damage to weapons. A Perfect roll can add 'Gain X% of Damage as Extra Physical Damage', a strong attack-crafting prefix.

members.title: Essence of Flame / Ice / Electricity
body: Each grants % Elemental Damage of its type. Lower tiers add flat elemental damage to Magic weapons; Perfect adds 'Gain X% of Damage as Extra' to a Rare weapon.

members.title: Essence of Insulation / Thawing / Grounding / Ruin
body: Grant Fire / Cold / Lightning / Chaos resistance respectively. Perfect rolls reach about +26-30% to the relevant resistance, with Ruin adding 'Physical Damage taken as Chaos'.

members.title: Essence of the Infinite
body: Grants increased Strength, Dexterity or Intelligence. Useful when you need to meet a gem or gear stat requirement without pathing through the tree.

members.title: Essence of Command
body: Increases Aura Magnitude on Sceptres. Relevant for support and summoner builds scaling ally damage.

members.title: Essence of Battle
body: Grants bonus Skill Levels to weapons. Exact per-weapon-class values are listed in the skill-level table below.

members.title: Essence of Sorcery
body: Grants bonus Spell Skill Levels to casters. Exact per-weapon-class values are listed in the skill-level table below.

members.title: Essence of Haste
body: Adds Attack Speed to weapons; Perfect can grant a chance to trigger Onslaught on kill, strong for clear speed.

members.title: Essence of Enhancement
body: Grants Global Defenses on Amulets, useful for Energy Shield or hybrid defence stacking builds.

sections.title: Which items an Essence works on
note: Eligibility depends on the tier. Lesser/Normal/Greater promote a Magic item to Rare. Perfect and Corrupted only act on an already-Rare item.

rows.note: Promotes a Magic item and adds one guaranteed mod

rows.label: Perfect / Corrupted
rows.note: Removes one mod, adds one strong mod

sections.title: How to get Essences
intro: Essences come primarily from map encounters, with a few supplementary routes.

routes.label: Essence monsters in maps
body: Crystalline prisons appear throughout maps. Breaking the crystal releases a trapped monster; defeating it drops the essence type shown on the crystal.

routes.label: Vaal Orb on the trapped monster
body: Using a Vaal Orb on the crystal before releasing can: do nothing, instantly release the monster, add extra essences, or upgrade one tier (Normal → Greater → Perfect → Corrupted).

routes.label: Vendor / Reforging Bench
body: Three of the same essence type and tier can be combined into one of the next tier. Confirm the exact recipe on the current client, as vendor behaviour changes between patches.

routes.label: Currency Exchange / trade
body: Buy specific essences from other players if you need a higher tier than you are finding.

sections.title: Crafting with Essences
paragraphs: Start with a Magic base that already has one desirable modifier. A Lesser/Normal/Greater essence promotes it to Rare and adds the guaranteed modifier, so you effectively 'lock in' one good affix for the cost of the essence plus the base.

For a finished item, a Perfect essence removes one random modifier and adds a powerful guaranteed one. Because the removed modifier is random, you should only use a Perfect essence on a Rare where losing any single modifier is acceptable - or pair it with an Omen of Crystallisation to choose the side.
bullets: Omen of Sinistral Crystallisation: your next Perfect/Corrupted essence removes only Prefix modifiers.
Omen of Dextral Crystallisation: your next Perfect/Corrupted essence removes only Suffix modifiers.
Stack the Omen with other crafting Omens (e.g. Exaltation) in the same inventory to combine effects.

steps.label: Pick the base
body: Choose a Magic item for Lesser-Greater, or a Rare for Perfect/Corrupted.

steps.label: Activate any Omen
body: Right-click the Omen of Crystallisation in your inventory so its red active border shows.

steps.label: Apply the Essence
body: Right-click the essence, then click the target item. The result is immediate and final.

compare.note: Lower tiers add a mod and promote; Perfect swaps one mod for a stronger one.
before: Rare chest with +Life suffix and a weak Cold-resist prefix.
after: Perfect Essence of the Body removes the weak prefix and adds +8-10% Maximum Life as the new prefix.

items.label: Right tier for the base
checks: Magic base for Lesser-Greater; Rare base for Perfect/Corrupted.
items.why: Wrong tier simply will not apply.
items.fix: Use a Regal/Transmutation first, or pick a different essence.

items.label: A safe mod can be lost
checks: On a Perfect/Corrupted use, confirm no single current mod is irreplaceable.
items.fix: Activate an Omen of Crystallisation to lock the side you keep.

items.label: Omen is active
checks: The Omen shows its red active border in the inventory.
items.fix: Right-click the Omen before applying the essence.

items.label: Cost vs base value
checks: Compare the essence cost to the value of the base if it succeeds or fails.
items.why: Expensive essences on cheap bases waste currency.
items.fix: Save high tiers for high-value bases.

sections.title: Which builds lean on Essences
intro: Essences are the go-to targeted craft when a build needs one specific, high-value modifier early.

builds.title: Caster builds
builds.description: Essence of Sorcery for +3 Spell Skills, or Essence of Enhancement for Global Defenses on the amulet.

builds.title: Attack / physical builds
builds.description: Essence of Abrasion (Extra Physical) or Essence of Battle (+Skill Levels) on the weapon.

builds.title: Tanky / HC builds
builds.description: Essence of the Body for Maximum Life, paired with resistance essences for cap fixes.

builds.title: Attribute-stacking builds
builds.description: Essence of the Infinite to hit gem or gear requirements without tree investment.

entries.question: Why did Perfect Essence delete my best modifier?
summary: A player used a Perfect essence on a Rare they liked and lost a modifier they wanted to keep.
editorialAnalysis: Perfect removes one random modifier unless an Omen of Crystallisation limits the side.
officialAnswer: Activate an Omen of Sinistral or Dextral Crystallisation before the Perfect essence to choose Prefix or Suffix removal.

entries.question: Should I Essence directly or prep with normal currency first?
summary: Players debate whether to start with an essence or build the base with orbs first.
editorialAnalysis: Use a Lesser/Greater essence to promote a base that already has one good mod; finish other rolls with normal currency before a Perfect swap.
officialAnswer: Essence first to lock the guaranteed mod, then fill remaining affixes with other currency.
